_comment: The single source of truth for what this app does with data. Three things are generated from it and must never drift apart: ios/App/PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy, store/app_privacy_details.json, and the published privacy policy page. Change this file, re-run the generators, do not hand-edit the outputs.
storesOnDevice: Which levels and daily puzzles you have cleared, in how many moves, and on which day — this is what the streak, the calendar and the level ladder are drawn from.
The board you are part-way through, rewritten after every pour, so closing or crashing the app never costs you a level.
Your settings: whether onboarding is done, which level you are on, and whether calm mode, the color-blind palette and the shape markers are switched on.

requiredReasonAPIs.why: @AppStorage and UserDefaults, used only for this app's own settings and the board in progress.

purchases.name: Tidepour Unlock
purchases.freeTier: The daily puzzle, the first 60 levels, your streak, the calendar, undo, restart and hints are free forever, with no advertising and nothing that runs out.

notifications.why: Tidepour sends no notifications at all. There is no streak reminder, because a streak you are nagged about is a job.

attribution: Every board is generated and solved on your device. Tidepour contains no third-party content, no third-party SDK and no network code of any kind.
